image_description: A close-up view of an industrial sawmill mechanism. The foreground features a wooden conveyor track with light-colored planks moving along it. Behind the track, there are large, rusty metal wheels and gears, part of the machinery driving the system. The background is cluttered with mechanical components, wood debris, and hints of yellow painted metal structures. The scene is gritty, with visible sawdust and wear on the equipment.
